description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dombagahewela, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Moneragala District - Cad. Map No. 720033
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership details, extents, and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
